description: This file contains internal function prototypes for the TLS Module Container Object, related to environment control, extension management, feature management, operational commands, and control interface registration within a Transport Layer Security implementation.

methods.name: TlsMcoGetTlsEnvController
methods.description: Returns the environment controller handle for the TLS module container object.

methods.name: TlsMcoEnrollExtensionObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary extension objects for the TLS module container object.

methods.name: TlsMcoManufactureExtensionObjects
methods.description: Creates or initializes extension objects for the TLS module container.

methods.name: TlsMcoDestroyExtensionObjects
methods.description: Destroys or deinitializes extension objects associated with the TLS module container.

methods.name: TlsMcoEnrollFeatureObjects
methods.description: Enrolls feature-related objects for the TLS module container.

methods.name: TlsMcoManufactureFeatureObjects
methods.description: Creates or initializes feature objects for the TLS module container.

methods.name: TlsMcoIgnite
methods.description: Activates or starts the TLS module container.

methods.name: TlsMcoPutOut
methods.description: Deactivates or stops the TLS module container.

methods.name: TlsMcoSwitch
methods.description: Switches the operational state of the TLS module container on or off.

methods.name: TlsMcoRegisterIfs
methods.description: Registers interface functions for the TLS module container.

methods.name: TlsMcoDispatchIfs
methods.description: Dispatches interface calls for handling specific interface interactions.
